rationale: VERSION 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0; complete canonical archetypes and a returned-grid canonical_profile_signature are now executable source artifacts, normalized only for rule-irrelevant color and common horizontal translation; the default complete-profile prior is independently keyed by difficulty and truthfully records grid_h, grid_w, top_wider, and strict_subset without mutating caller-override provenance; texture='full_width' now draws strict_subset from the feasible singleton True; explicit False rejects loudly, eliminating 232/1000 medium and 398/1000 hard default-provenance substitutions; explicit texture='none' is identical to omission; unknown textures, palette kinds, overrides, non-bool boolean controls, and non-int dimension controls reject instead of coercing or falling through; self_check now enforces the declared 9..24 by 4..11 envelope and integer-color contract in addition to separator/bar topology; non-subset construction is fail-closed: _pick_bars raises if no spill exists and single_shared_col enumerates lawful candidates instead of retrying then falling back; top_wider, strict_subset, palette_kind, texture, color, geometry, and row placement use separate keyed draws; all four edge modes are exported as HELPFUL_TEXTURES for standard lint coverage; easy mode now uses a 90/10 subset/spill generalized mix, lifting returned spill witnesses from 6.6% to 12.7% while preserving the easy < medium < hard semantic gradient; added 11 focused test groups covering public pairs, complete profiles, parity mirror, exact controls, forced-mode provenance, named texture grammar, recombination rejection, envelope mutations, deterministic fresh returns, and palette realization
summary: A tall narrow grid has one all-2 separator row, one contiguous bar row above and one below in a shared non-{2,4} color. Columns present in BOTH bars are filled with 4 between the strictly wider bar and the separator; the narrower side never fills.
